properties.description: Drives the MCP surface: the owner agent's write path (5/2/6/20 with 13 beside the commit; path 33, sum 46) judged within 40 on its path when declared `path`; kept on the sum and named when undeclared; incomplete when a path budget has no dependency drawn; an unknown composition refused naming the set; budget_report with no constraint_id reads every budget, counts the prohibition, and is bounded; constrains names DEPENDS_ON and composition. The core file crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_budget_says_how_it_composes.rs pins every reader of the verdict (closure margin, sweep, minimum, unstated path).
properties.findings: Failing first on a clean origin/main build (42259ba) under the shared lock: 7 of 7 failed. On the fix: 7 of 7 pass; core 10 new + budget 15 + kpp 12 pass; clippy -D warnings clean on both crates.
properties.name: A budget declares sum or path, its verdict and every other reader follow the declaration, and one read reports every budget
